title: Simply Server
description: If you are looking but can't find the perfect modpack for server gameplay. well Simply server has it all. Resource packs, shaders, and voice chat. everything you need just for a serevr
body:
Wanting to find a modpack for servers but you just can't, well simply server has you coverd. Simply server includes shaders, reasorce packs, and fps/dynamics improvements. Simply server also gives to mods to use on your singlepayer worlds and has no effect on them.
